title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is a paper signal. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The live record for v005 begins on 1 October 2026, and the live record for v006 begins on 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. A single trade does not say anything about a strategy, and the record is reported as it stands.

## Paper signals and the first closed trade

The framing is paper only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The live record for v005 counts from 1 October 2026, so the ATOM entry at 2.066 on 10 October 2026 falls inside that record. The live record for v006 counts from 9 October 2026, so the NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 also falls inside its record. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The entry and exit levels are 2.066 and 1.703, and the result is −17.9%. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since, so its outcome is not yet in the closed-trade averages. In testing, the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The ATOM entry and exit form the first closed live trade in the record. The record does not turn that expectation into a claim about any future result.

## Open and closed positions across the engines

htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper. It has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade; the record reports that average as null rather than as a percentage. trend-daily-v005 shows 0 positions open on paper. It has 6 closed trades so far, with an average −13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 shows 0 positions open on paper. It has 7 closed trades so far, with an average −13.34% net per trade. htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades and an average null net per trade; trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades and an average −13.22% net per trade; trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades and an average −13.34% net per trade. All three engines show 0 positions open on paper at the snapshot time. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 remains open, so it is not part of those closed-trade averages. The ATOM trade described above is closed. These are the open and closed counts in the live record at the snapshot time. A closed-trade average is a measurement of the paper record, not a projection. The closed-trade counts are complete counts of closed live trades for each engine at the snapshot time.

## Market filter state

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. Both engines show 0 positions open on paper. The Bitcoin market filter is off for trend-daily-v005 and for trend-daily-v006, and both engines show 0 positions open on paper. The record states the filter state and the position count; it does not state a mechanism beyond those fields. No position is open in either trend-daily engine at the snapshot time. The filter state is part of the live record and can change. The record does not say whether the filter being off precedes or follows the zero position count.

## Distance to the 20-day breakout levels

The record lists the closest names to their 20-day breakout levels. For trend-daily-v005, TRXUSDT is 13.34% below its high, XLMUSDT is 17.87% below its high, and AVAXUSDT is 18.82% below its high. For trend-daily-v006, JUPUSDT is 5.46% below its high, TRXUSDT is 13.34% below its high, and XLMUSDT is 17.87% below its high. These are distance measurements in the live record. They are not entries, exits, or recommendations. The distances are measured from the high, as recorded. TRXUSDT at 13.34% below its high appears in both lists, and XLMUSDT at 17.87% below its high appears in both lists. AVAXUSDT at 18.82% below its high appears only in the v005 list, and JUPUSDT at 5.46% below its high appears only in the v006 list. The list names the closest names, not every name.

## Where the same numbers appear

The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The performance page, the signal log, and the channel status post are the places where the same numbers appear. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-16T09:13:18.034Z. The live record updates continuously, so the counts, averages, filter state, and distances can change after that time. The page reports the record as it stands and does not project from it. The counts, averages, filter state, and distances above are as of that snapshot.
